scope: Node VM regression tests plus automated real-browser E2E (playwright, headless Chromium)
fixedInThisVersion: Commit 1bdeb9b shipped an index.html that differed from the released v1.48.0 while still declaring APP_VERSION v1.48.0 and the same APP_BUILD. Two different builds claimed one version. Renamed to v1.49.0 and paired with extension 1.4.11.
versions.json now records every shipped version with the SHA-256 of index.html and extension/app.js, measured from git rather than written by hand.
tests/test-release-manifest.cjs is in the gate: changing content under a shipped version, leaving APP_BUILD behind, or recording one build under two versions each fail.
regressionProof: All three mistakes were reproduced and each fails the new suite: editing index.html without a bump, keeping the old APP_BUILD, and recording the same index.html hash under two versions.
notVerified: the OpenRouter route request shape. openrouter.ai is blocked by this environment network policy, so the chat/completions envelope is declared verified:false and labelled as such in the settings UI.
this build on a real Chrome profile.
the turn decision layer above turnDecisionMode=off. The default is off and the suites assert parity with v1.47.1 at that setting.
